We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case: person used fire for ancestor tomb sweeping, caused forest fire, burned forest area 8.4 hectares. In examples, similar facts: forest fire caused by negligence or intentional? In examples, they labeled as "失火" (wildfire) for cases where fire caused unintentionally (e.g., using fire for祭祖, etc). Also "放火" used when intentional arson (deliberate). Let's see: In example: Liu case: "因烧火冥纸不慎将山林引燃" => answer "失火". Another: Wu case: used打火机点燃被褥 intentionally? That was "放火". So distinction: "失火" = accidental fire (negligent). "放火" = intentional arson. Here: "因用火不慎，引发了森林火灾" => accidental. So answer likely "失火". Also maybe "非法采伐"? No. So single crime: 失火.

Thus output format: [罪名]失火<eoa>
